description: Extract text from PDF, Word, PowerPoint or image files (including scanned pages) via DeepSeek's OCR API. Returns the recognized text per page. Set purpose=rich_layout_recognition to force page-by-page layout-aware recognition (better for complex layouts); the default text_recognition extracts plain text directly from image-free Word/PPT files.

file_path.description: Local path of the file to recognize (PDF, Word, PPT or image). Absolute path recommended.

name: deepseek_ocr
title: DeepSeek OCR
